title: Law to create a watch list for bad shelter food vendors
summary: This bill would require the Department of Homeless Services and the Department for the Aging to jointly publish an annual watch list of food vendors serving shelters and senior centers that repeatedly fail food quality or safety standards. Vendors with three or more corrective action plans or compliance failures in two years, or a pattern of systemic food quality problems over three years, would be listed, and subcontracts with listed vendors would be rescinded unless the vendor completes a review process. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
